text:
Maria: quick q — during yesterday's nsys run i noticed a bunch of tiny ranges labeled 'kernel' with no context. can we land better NVTX names for kernel selection steps?
Sam: yeah saw that too. makes it hard to map the hotspot to kvcache vs batcher. :eyes: 
Oliver: i think the runtime currently tags at high level: 'execute_kernel' then dumps subops into one blob. we should add per-request spans: `nvtxRangePushA("req:<id>:kernel:<kind>")` so traces correlate to request id and kernel kind.
Jen: per-request ids are sensitive — we need to avoid leaking PII in traces. use short hex or incremental local id, e.g. `r1234`, not full user ids.
Maria: agreed — short request id. also we should add a tag for kernel selector decision reason: e.g. `kselect:quantized` or `kselect:float16_fallback`. that helps when perf regression changes kernel choice.
Sam: good idea. for batching heuristics, can we add ranges around `batcher.dequeue` and `batcher.pack` with expected batch size as metadata? current timeline shows big idle gaps but no context.
Oliver: nvtx supports string payloads but weight is limited. we can do two ranges: `batch:wait` and `batch:form(sz=8)` so perf tools show both wait and pack time.
perf-bot: auto-report: nsys run 2026-03-17 22:12:45 — top GPU kernels: matmul_v2, softmax_fused, kv_cache_lookup.
Maria: that perf-bot report aligns — kv_cache_lookup is spiking. we need a NVTX span around KV cache path including hit/miss semantics: `kvcache:lookup:hit` or `kvcache:lookup:miss` (misses should be annotated).
Jen: how expensive is annotating every cache lookup? heatmap adds overhead. maybe only annotate misses or sampled requests (1%).
Sam: sampling is fine. let's do deterministic sampling by request id mod 256 to keep reproducible traces. add a runtime flag `--nvtx-sample-mod=256`.
Oliver: also propose naming conventions doc: lowercase, colon separators, limited tokens: component:op:detail. examples: `req:r123:kernel:matmul`, `batch:wait`, `kv:lookup:miss`. keeps perf queryable.
Maria: +1. final note on kernel selection: annotate the selector with the candidate list and chosen index in a compact form, e.g. `kselect:[q8,fp16,tf32]->idx=1` (but keep it short).
Sam: will prototype in a branch. Plan: add ranges for batch wait/pack, add sampled kv miss spans, add kernel selector span with short candidate tag. will run nsys + perfetto and share.
Jen: please add a changelog entry and a short config toggle so we can A/B test overhead.
Maria: awesome — @Sam assign a PR and ping eng-runtime for review when ready.
Sam: on it. creating PR now.
perf-bot: link to run/trace: http://perf.internal/runs/1799987654 (sampled traces attached)
Maria: grabbing those traces now — thanks!
